page.layout: One printed page of running text, set in one column, with a closing line, initials and a signature below it. The strip at the right edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: mente & manu accipientes, me studiaque mea vobis, ut hactenus, de meliore nota commendata esse patiamini. DEUS Opt. Max. cui per Seruatorem Iesum Christum, vota nostra nuncupamus, vos ani-mo & corpore valentes & incolu-mes ad ædificationem Scholæ & Ecclesiæ, sustentet quàm diutis-simé. Bernæ ex musæo nostro, An-no salutis restauratæ M. D. C. V. mense Iulio.

page.notes: No page number or running head is printed on this page. The right-hand strip shows the edge of the neighbouring page and the faint show-through of the other side; neither is transcribed. The left edge of the page is partly obscured by a scanning artefact, but the text is fully legible. The initials "V. R. D." are set centred and the signature "Iohannes Huldricus Herlinus." is in italic.
